label: 4a. Short length
descr limit: Descriptions are limitted to 100 characters. This is 100 characters for reference.
description: Videos must be 30 seconds or longer not including intros/outros/credits/etc.
full: Videos must be 30 seconds or longer not including intros/outros/credits/etc.

label: 4b. Unsuitable vote
description: Videos which are highly derivative, intended for children, very low effort, etc.
full: Videos which are highly derivative, intended for children, very low effort, etc. are not eligible.

label: 4d. Questionable content
description: Videos with primary focus to offend, disturb, shock, or are overtly sexual/fetishistic in nature
full: Videos with a primary focus to offend, disturb, shock, or videos that are overtly sexual/fetishistic in nature are not eligible. Most mature content is fine as long as it's comedic/satirical and/or has significant artistic merit.

label: 4e. "Pony" definition
description: Videos must primarily focus on My Little Pony, bronies, or be widely adopted by the brony community.
full: Videos must have My Little Pony and/or bronies as the primary focus, or have been widely adopted by the brony community.

label: 4f. "Video" definition
description: Must be completed videos with visual effort and appeal. Videos must be in a final finished state.
full: Votes must be actual, completed videos with visual effort and appeal. Videos must be in a final state with a more-complete version not expected to release.

label: 4g. Re-uploads/deleted videos
description: Older videos that have been re-uploaded are not eligible.
full: Older videos that have been re-uploaded are not eligible.

label: 5b. Non-community videos
description: Don't vote for non-community videos. For example: videos made by large companies such as Hasbro.
full: Don't vote for non-community videos. For example: videos made by large companies such as Hasbro are not eligible.
